articles.headline: SC: No illegal detention, ensure net not disrupted
articles.blurb: The Supreme Court, amid anti-CEC protests in New Delhi, sought normal metro operations and directed that there be no illegal detention and that internet services not be disrupted; around 200 people were detained on Sunday, with notice to the Centre in a contempt plea.

articles.headline: Over 340 acres of forest converted into revenue land in Kolar dist
articles.blurb: An Assistant Commissioner’s order converting over 340 acres of forest into revenue land in Kolar district, including the Abbi Mini Forest area, could legalise encroachments, the report said.

articles.headline: Shivakumar met person involved in sting operation: HDK
articles.blurb: Union Minister H.D. Kumaraswamy accused Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar of meeting a middleman linked to a sting operation at a five-star hotel.

articles.headline: B’luru sees first grassroots protest against new flyovers
articles.blurb: Residents held a human-chain protest against the Raghupathi–Kanakapura Main Road elevated corridor project under B-SMILE in Bengaluru.

articles.headline: Indian among 13 killed in attack on Saudi’s Riyadh airport
articles.blurb: An Indian was among 13 killed in a drone attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport, attributed to Houthi rebels.

articles.headline: Grand start to Dasara
articles.blurb: Mysuru Dasara opened with ceremonies at Chamundeshwari temple atop Chamundi Hill, with Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar and a pontiff among those present.

articles.headline: K’taka plans paid consultancy to share governance models
articles.blurb: Karnataka plans paid consultancy to other states on e-governance models such as FRUITS and Kutumba, with IT/BT Minister Priyank Kharge cited.

articles.headline: India outlast Windies in high-scoring clash
articles.blurb: Abhishek Sharma set up India’s win and Arshdeep Singh took three wickets as India beat West Indies in a high-scoring T20 clash.

articles.headline: Starlink competition will benefit Indian consumers: Musk
articles.blurb: Elon Musk said Starlink competition would benefit Indian consumers.

articles.headline: Punjab woman held for spying
articles.blurb: A Punjab woman was held in a spying case, the Nation brief reported.

articles.headline: Nana Patekar died of heart attack: Autopsy
articles.blurb: An autopsy found actor Nana Patekar died of a heart attack.

articles.headline: IndiGo flight diverted
articles.blurb: A Chennai-bound IndiGo flight from Delhi was diverted to Hyderabad after smoke was reported onboard.

articles.headline: Online date turns into AI-enabled sextortion bid
articles.blurb: A 23-year-old in Bengaluru lost ₹1.65 lakh in an AI-enabled sextortion attempt after an online date, a Quickly item said.

articles.headline: 139 migrants die after boat capsizes off Djibouti
articles.blurb: About 139 migrants died after a boat capsized off Djibouti.

articles.headline: PM vows support to TN
articles.blurb: Prime Minister Narendra Modi, at a Chennai Metro Phase-II event with Tamil Nadu CM M.K. Stalin, vowed support to Tamil Nadu.

articles.headline: 5 people missing as flash floods hit Nepal
articles.blurb: Five people were missing after flash floods in Nepal.

articles.headline: Sixth POCSO case against TN granite baron
articles.blurb: A sixth POCSO case was registered against Tamil Nadu granite baron R. Veeramani, a Quickly item said.

articles.headline: Beyond assembly: Yaanendriya aims to own autonomy IP
articles.blurb: A Business brief flagged deeptech startup Yaanendriya’s push to own autonomy IP (full report inside).

articles.headline: 139 migrants, including 15 kids, die after boat overturns off Djibouti
articles.blurb: An overcrowded boat heading to Yemen overturned off Djibouti, killing 139 migrants including 15 children, with 64 still missing; IOM workers assisted survivors.

articles.headline: Nepal flash floods sweep away houses, five people missing
articles.blurb: Flash floods in central Nepal swept away houses after debris blocked a river, with five people missing.

articles.headline: Russia, Ukraine agreed to ‘energy truce’, claims Trump
articles.blurb: Donald Trump claimed Russia and Ukraine agreed to an energy truce; Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he was unaware of any such development, as Kyiv targeted Moscow’s tech infrastructure.

articles.headline: Poland PM’s ‘assassination’ suspect held
articles.blurb: A suspect was detained over an alleged assassination attempt on the Polish prime minister.

articles.headline: Pope to be operated on for lump on lung
articles.blurb: Pope Leo XIV was scheduled for surgery for a lung lump at Gemelli Hospital.

articles.headline: 72 killed in airstrike on gold mine on Sudan-Egypt border
articles.blurb: An Egyptian military aircraft strike on a gold mine on the Sudan–Egypt border killed 72 people, the report said.

articles.headline: UN officials call for urgent, science-backed systemic solutions to heat crisis
articles.blurb: UN officials urged urgent, science-backed systemic solutions to the heat crisis.

articles.headline: Give priority to Godavari-Cauvery interlinking: Vijay to PM
articles.blurb: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, at Chennai project launches worth over ₹13,000 crore with PM Modi, sought priority for Godavari–Cauvery interlinking and an interstate Hosur–Bengaluru metro corridor.

articles.headline: Modi opens Chennai Metro corridor, vows support to TN
articles.blurb: Prime Minister Narendra Modi opened a Chennai Metro Phase-II corridor and vowed continued support to Tamil Nadu.

articles.headline: Starlink competition will benefit Indian consumers: Musk
articles.blurb: Elon Musk said Starlink’s entry and competition would benefit Indian consumers versus existing players.

articles.headline: Chennai-bound flight diverted after ‘smoke’ onboard
articles.blurb: An IndiGo Delhi–Chennai flight diverted to Hyderabad after smoke was detected from a passenger’s electronic device.

articles.headline: Pressure mounts on Keralam government to resume Wayanad tunnel project
articles.blurb: Pressure mounted on the Kerala government to resume the contested 8.1 km Meppadi–Aanakkampoyil Wayanad tunnel road project.

articles.headline: Patekar died of heart attack: Autopsy
articles.blurb: An autopsy at a Goa hospital found actor Nana Patekar died of acute myocardial infarction.

articles.headline: HC bench: ‘DC-headed panel will be set up to prepare infra assessment checklist’
articles.blurb: District in-charge Minister U.T. Khader said a Deputy Commissioner-headed panel would prepare an infrastructure assessment checklist for a High Court circuit or permanent bench in Mangaluru, and that efforts would be made to build consensus among districts.

articles.headline: MUDA chairman inspects sites for cricket stadium
articles.blurb: MUDA Chairman Sadashiv Ullal inspected sites including Bangra, Bondel, Mullur, Kannuru and Kenjar for a well-equipped cricket stadium sought by the Karnataka State Cricket Association.

articles.headline: 1,128 passengers take KSRTC Dasara package tours on launch day
articles.blurb: KSRTC Mangaluru Division’s special Dasara package tours carried 1,128 passengers on launch day from Bejai bus stand to temples and tourist destinations.

articles.headline: Navaratri celebrations off to grand, colourful note
articles.blurb: Mangaluru Dasara began at Sri Gokarnanatha Temple, Kudroli, with Navadurga idol installation, Alpana art, processions and Huli Vesha performances on the first day.

articles.headline: Conspiracy underway to deprive indigenous communities of voting rights
articles.blurb: Jina Prakash Swamiji of Udupi alleged a conspiracy to deprive indigenous communities of voting rights.

articles.headline: Police issue traffic advisory in view of Dasara
articles.blurb: Mangaluru City Police issued a traffic and parking advisory for Dasara near Kudroli temple.

articles.headline: Fifth edition of Uchila Dasara begins
articles.blurb: Dakshina Kannada Deputy Commissioner Swaroopa T.K. flagged off the fifth Uchila Dasara Mahotsava at Uchila Mahalakshmi Temple, Padubidri.

articles.headline: Swachh M’luru Abhiyan volunteers clean rly station rd
articles.blurb: Ramakrishna Mission’s Swachh Mangaluru Abhiyan volunteers cleaned Railway Station Road.

articles.headline: Dasara Poets’ Meet today
articles.blurb: A Dasara Poets’ Meet was scheduled at Sri Gokarnanatha Temple.

articles.headline: Student’s body traced
articles.blurb: The body of 21-year-old student Akash, missing after entering the sea at Periwal Beach, was traced.

articles.headline: No double-jeopardy benefit for repeated mining sans nod: HC
articles.blurb: The Karnataka High Court held a Bagalkot man who mined ruby-red granite on his own land without nod could not claim double-jeopardy protection for repeated offences, citing CrPC and constitutional provisions.

articles.headline: Elderly man orders dry fruits online, cheated of Rs 2.86L
articles.blurb: An 80-year-old resident of Telecom Layout, Bengaluru, lost ₹2.86 lakh in a Facebook-ad dry-fruit cyber fraud via UPI.

articles.headline: 300 organisations, 80 artistes sign up for Bengaluru Jatre
articles.blurb: About 300 organisations and 80 artistes signed up for Bengaluru’s Namma Jatre, with Greener Bengaluru Development Minister Krishna Byre Gowda among those cited.

articles.headline: Form 7 FIRs: BYV warns of laying siege to police stations
articles.blurb: BJP state president B.Y. Vijayendra warned of laying siege to police stations over FIRs against BJP workers linked to Form 7 objections.

articles.headline: Online date turns into AI-enabled sextortion bid
articles.blurb: A 23-year-old Bengaluru man lost money after being threatened with an AI-manipulated obscene video; the state reported 57 sextortion cases till August.

articles.headline: Panel to study rationalisation of tiger reserve buffer zones
articles.blurb: A technical committee set up by the State Board of Wildlife, chaired by Chief Minister Siddaramaiah, will review buffer zones for Bandipur and Bhadra tiger reserves.

articles.headline: Kharge accuses Centre of imposing undeclared Emergency
articles.blurb: AICC president Mallikarjun Kharge, speaking in Kalaburagi, accused the Centre of imposing an undeclared Emergency.

articles.headline: Centre tarnishing India’s reputation for democracy, says Shivakumar
articles.blurb: Deputy Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar said the Centre was tarnishing India’s democratic reputation, citing the Special Intensive Revision exercise.

articles.headline: BMTC to launch 5 dedicated feeder buses for Pink Line metro stations
articles.blurb: BMTC planned five dedicated feeder buses for Pink Line stations including Hulimavu, Tavarekere, Jayanagar and JP Nagar 4th Phase.

articles.headline: Notice to Indira Canteen contractor for menu violations
articles.blurb: BBMP officials issued a notice to an Indira Canteen contractor after inspections found menu violations.

articles.headline: B’luru GPO sees huge interest from stamp collectors for philately passports
articles.blurb: Bengaluru GPO saw heavy demand from stamp collectors for philately passports.

articles.headline: Gavi Mutt seer calls upon people to preserve legacy of harmony
articles.blurb: Koppal Gavi Mutt pontiff Gaviddeshwara Swamy inaugurated Mysuru Dasara, recalling Wadiyars’ contributions, with CM D.K. Shivakumar and ministers present.

articles.headline: Dasara begins at Mysuru Palace with private durbar
articles.blurb: Yaduveer Krishnadatta Chamaraja Wadiyar held a private durbar at Mysuru Palace as Dasara began for a selected audience.

articles.headline: HDK continues ‘sting’ attack, accuses Shivakumar of meeting person involved in ops
articles.blurb: H.D. Kumaraswamy continued accusing D.K. Shivakumar of meeting a person linked to sting operations.

articles.headline: More elderly women face abuse within family than senior men: Data
articles.blurb: Elderline Helpline and Nightingales Medical Trust data showed more elderly women than senior men face abuse within families in Bengaluru.

articles.headline: Three killed, nine injured as lorry rear-ends tractor
articles.blurb: Three people were killed and nine injured when a lorry rear-ended a tractor carrying a Durga Devi idol on NH-48 near Hukkeri, Belagavi district.

articles.headline: Over 340 acres of forest converted into revenue land
articles.blurb: A continuation from page 1 covered conversion of over 340 acres of forest into revenue land in Kolar district.

articles.headline: Former GP member killed by unidentified assailants
articles.blurb: Former gram panchayat member Madivalappa Madiwalappa Madivalar was killed by unidentified assailants in Gadag.

articles.headline: Detentions don’t deter protesters; bigger mobilisation likely today
articles.blurb: Detention of Constitutional Justice Party protesters in Delhi did not stop the stir; INDIA bloc leaders including Mallikarjun Kharge and Rahul Gandhi planned to march to the Supreme Court with a memorandum for the CJI.

articles.headline: Keralam CM to move resolution against CEC in Assembly today
articles.blurb: Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan was set to move an Assembly resolution seeking removal of CEC Gyanesh Kumar, with LDF and UDF expected to support and BJP to oppose.

articles.headline: Deploying 40k cops proof that stir was successful: PK
articles.blurb: Jan Suraaj founder Prashant Kishor said deploying about 40,000 police at Jantar Mantar proved the anti-CEC agitation’s impact.

articles.headline: Four held, but saffron-clad groups remain on Delhi streets
articles.blurb: Four men were arrested over an assault linked to tensions between protesters and saffron-clad groups in Delhi.

articles.headline: Journalists detained despite credentials
articles.blurb: At least a dozen journalists covering the protests were detained by Delhi Police despite press credentials; press bodies condemned the action.

articles.headline: Delhi Police have lost their sense of justice: Brittas
articles.blurb: CPI(M) MP John Brittas said he was detained and manhandled at Connaught Place and nearly choked in a police van.

articles.headline: ‘An embarrassment to India’: CJP trains guns on PM
articles.blurb: CJP criticised Prime Minister Narendra Modi over the crackdown; co-conveners Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were released from preventive detention.

articles.headline: I was not detained; I was kidnapped: Dhruv Rathee
articles.blurb: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee said about 20 plainclothes persons took him from his Gurugram residence and held him about 22 hours without lawyer or phone access.

articles.headline: Deport actor Imran Khan: BJP leader
articles.blurb: BJP leader Kirit Somaiya called for deporting actor Imran Khan, alleging he is a US citizen who joined illegal protests.

articles.headline: Thackeray cousins join anti-CEC protests in Mumbai
articles.blurb: Aaditya, Tejas and Amit Thackeray joined anti-CEC protests in Mumbai at Dadar and outside Vashi police station.

articles.headline: CJP has shifted its focus to electoral politics, claims BJP
articles.blurb: BJP spokesperson Sudhanshu Trivedi accused CJP of shifting into electoral politics.

articles.headline: Sikh body files police complaint against Kejriwal, AAP
articles.blurb: DSGMC filed a police complaint against Arvind Kejriwal and AAP over alleged misleading videos on the anti-CEC protests.

articles.headline: An authoritarian reflex in the national capital (Opinion)
articles.blurb: The editorial criticised the Union government’s crackdown on Delhi protests after CEC-related unrest, citing Section 144, metro shutdowns and heavy security deployment.

articles.headline: A vital democratic space reopens (Opinion)
articles.blurb: The editorial welcomed the return of student union elections in Karnataka colleges after 37 years, citing Lyngdoh Committee norms and warning against political patronage.

articles.headline: Geography returns as conflicts grow (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Raghu Gururaj argued geopolitics and weaponised trade are restoring physical geography’s centrality, citing Ukraine, the South China Sea and the Arctic.

articles.headline: The stories books carry (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Sanjeev Gandhi’s essay reflected on how books preserve memories of people who gifted or shared them.

articles.headline: The era of easy money is over (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Vasant G. Hegde analysed the RBI MPC’s 25-basis-point repo-rate rise to 5.25% amid inflation and global policy tightening.

articles.headline: The Shastri standard and the diminishing culture of accountability (Opinion)
articles.blurb: A. Ravindra contrasted Lal Bahadur Shastri’s resignation after a rail accident with weaker modern accountability, citing NEET-leak and Karnataka Valmiki Corporation controversies.

articles.headline: Plantations are not failed forests (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Jagmohan Sharma defended Karnataka Forest Department plantation strategy, citing ISFR 2023 and FAO distinctions between natural forests and managed plantations.

articles.headline: Wringing hope from the rubble of Gaza
articles.blurb: Aaron Boxerman (NYT) reported on Gazans, including injured children, rebuilding lives amid war rubble.

articles.headline: Patience breeds success (Opinion)
articles.blurb: Surendra Pai’s Oasis essay used a Buddha parable about a muddy stream to argue patience brings clarity.

articles.headline: India’s lab-grown diamond dreams shine beyond the stones
articles.blurb: India aims to move from cutting and polishing lab-grown diamonds to technology, brands and retail; wholesale prices fell sharply while markets project strong growth, the report said.

articles.headline: Mis-selling not widespread in general insurance segment: IFFCO-TOKIO director
articles.blurb: IFFCO-TOKIO director Alpana Singh said mis-selling is not widespread in general insurance and the company will expand retail auto and health portfolios.

articles.headline: Beyond assembly: Yaanendriya aims to own autonomy IP
articles.blurb: Bengaluru deeptech startup Yaanendriya, founded in 2023 and incubated at ARTIPARK, IISc, raised seed funding to build autonomy stacks for drones and aerospace rather than assembly alone.

articles.headline: GST overhaul: Lighter penalties, more certainty
articles.blurb: Prabhakar K.S. outlined GST Council changes including lighter penalties, registration reforms, late-fee waivers, faster refunds and a higher arrest threshold of ₹5 crore.

articles.headline: State planters seek Rs 50L relief for wildlife deaths
articles.blurb: The Karnataka Planters’ Association sought ₹50 lakh compensation for loss of life in human–wildlife conflict in Kodagu, Hassan and Chikkamagaluru, alongside coffee production estimates.

articles.headline: Consolidation likely this week
articles.blurb: Market columnist Siddharta Khemka expected consolidation, listing key events including India CPI/WPI and major Q2 earnings.

articles.headline: Infosys sees no material impact from PERM move
articles.blurb: Infosys said a possible US Labor Department suspension of new PERM applications would have no material impact given its US local workforce.

articles.headline: AI should amplify human potential, not replace it, says Infosys Chief HR Officer Mathew
articles.blurb: Infosys CHRO Shaji Mathew said AI should amplify human potential through re-skilling and Human+AI decision-making, not replace people.

articles.headline: In Dharashiv, the soybean harvest that never came
articles.blurb: Maharashtra Marathwada farmers in Dharashiv (Tuljapur) said no fresh rain can salvage the failed kharif soybean harvest, comparing conditions to the 1972 drought.

articles.headline: Punjab woman held, 2 Army personnel under probe for spying
articles.blurb: Punjab Counter Intelligence arrested a woman for allegedly sending Army installation information to Pakistan’s ISI; two Army personnel were under probe.

articles.headline: Kashmir’s pesticide-free apple claim puts breast-milk exposure question in focus
articles.blurb: A SKUAST-K study finding pesticide residues in human milk raised questions about Kashmir’s pesticide-free apple claims and food-safety exposure.

articles.headline: Abhishek fires with bat before Arshdeep checks the chase
articles.blurb: Abhishek Sharma’s 69 and Arshdeep Singh’s three wickets paved the way for India’s 14-run win over West Indies in the third T20I at Indore; India led the five-match series 2–1.

articles.headline: Smaran holds Karnataka together
articles.blurb: Stand-in skipper Smaran R scored 125 as Karnataka posted 274 all out against Andhra in the Ranji Trophy opener in Bengaluru; Andhra were 16/2 at stumps.

articles.headline: Menno’s India adventure begins a rollercoaster ride
articles.blurb: Dutch defender Menno Koch of Bengaluru FC scored on debut in the 32nd minute against SC Delhi in the ISL.

articles.headline: New Zealand name split ODI squad for India series
articles.blurb: New Zealand named a split ODI squad for the India series from November 4, with Rachin Ravindra returning and Tom Latham to captain the first three matches.

articles.headline: Aus take charge as Smith grabs record
articles.blurb: Steve Smith equalled the world record for catches by a fielder (20) on day three of the first Test against South Africa in Durban.

articles.headline: Sinchal clears golden hurdle
articles.blurb: Sinchal Kaveramma won gold in the women’s 400m hurdles at the National Open Athletics Championships in New Delhi in 58.40s.

articles.headline: India A score consolation win
articles.blurb: India A beat Australia A by 49 runs in Puducherry, with Suryakumar Yadav (66) and Ruturaj Gaikwad (58) starring.

articles.headline: Udhayveer claims gold
articles.blurb: Udhayveer Sidhu won gold in the men’s 25m pistol at the ISSF World Cup in Cairo.

articles.headline: Jaandaar bags Pune Derby
articles.blurb: Jaandaar won the Pune Derby, the racing brief reported.

articles.headline: Tanishka adds another feather to her cap
articles.blurb: Tanishka Kanthilal finished runner-up in the U-17 category at the Asian Junior Tennis Championships.

articles.headline: Forest get lost in Palace
articles.blurb: Crystal Palace beat Nottingham Forest 3–1; Yeremy Pino was among the scorers.

articles.headline: Hull fight back after falling behind to deny Everton; Spurs frustrate United
articles.blurb: Hull City drew 2–2 with Everton and Manchester United drew 1–1 with Tottenham Hotspur.

articles.headline: Barca extend perfect streak
articles.blurb: Barcelona beat Getafe 2–0 to extend their perfect streak.

articles.headline: Zheng reigns supreme at home
articles.blurb: Qinwen Zheng won the China Open title, defeating Mirra Andreeva.

articles.headline: Gea stuns Shelton
articles.blurb: French player Arthur Gea defeated Ben Shelton at the Shanghai Masters.

articles.headline: It's two in two for Verstappen
articles.blurb: Max Verstappen won the Singapore Grand Prix, with Charles Leclerc second and Lewis Hamilton third.

articles.headline: Ishaan, Krishay share honours
articles.blurb: Ishaan Madesh (Bengaluru) and Krishay Gade (Mumbai) shared honours in round three of the MRF Indian National Racing Championship at the Madras International Circuit.

articles.headline: Kipchoge ends 3-year wait
articles.blurb: Eliud Kipchoge ended a three-year wait with a marathon victory in Melbourne.
